From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: corndog

English

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • corndog

Etymology

[edit]

Blend of cornbread +‎ hotdog.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Audio (US):(file)

Noun

[edit]

corn dog (plural corn dogs)

  1. A hot dog coated in cornbread batter and deep-fried in hot oil.
    Synonyms: (Australia) dagwood dog, Pluto pup
    Hyponym: (corn dog on a stick) pogo
